scripts.build: bun run --filter @brawlhalla-sim/replay-format build && bun run --filter @brawlhalla-sim/core build
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run smoke:packages && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @brawlhalla-sim/replay-format typecheck && bun run --filter @brawlhalla-sim/core typecheck && bun run --filter @brawlhalla-sim/avm2-provenance typecheck
